about: ⑤ Motion render presets for LTX-2.5 Layout-to-Render. Read by soundstage/ltx_settings.py and web/motion/ltxadvanced.mjs. Measured in share/Milestone18_Hollywood/REPORT.txt.

Draft.label: Draft
Draft.tip: A quick look: 8 + 3 steps, 1080p class. Faces readable, motion approximate.

Final.label: Final
Final.tip: Clean motion and detail: 12 + 6 steps, 1080p class, high-bitrate H.264. The default.

Hollywood.label: Hollywood (max)
Hollywood.tip: The best this GPU does: 1408p (stage 1 at 704p, x2), 12 + 6 steps, near-lossless master. About 15 min a shot.

adherence.about: ⑤ Motion › Adherence: how tightly the render follows the clay blocking. Measured in share/Blocking_Adherence/REPORT.txt. Advanced (LTX) can override each raw value per shot.

Loose.label: Loose
Loose.tip: More invention: a softened clay guide and a lighter Layout IC-LoRA. Natural motion, but positions and framing can drift (the old default).

Balanced.label: Balanced
Balanced.tip: Close to the clay with a little freedom for gait and limbs.

Exact.label: Exact
Exact.tip: As close to the clay as LTX goes: a sharp clay guide, the full Layout IC-LoRA, and your frame as a lighter look reference so it can't pull the shot off its marks.
